proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H n hn hn0
  refine ⟨H.normalCore, inferInstance, H.normalCore_le, ?_⟩
  have : Finite (G ⧸ H) := by
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [← Subgroup.index_eq_card, hn]; exact hn0
  rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker, Subgroup.index_ker]
  have h1 := Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range
  rwa [Nat.card_perm, ← Subgroup.index_eq_card, hn] at h1
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (n : ℕ), H.index = n → n ≠ 0 → ∃ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal ∧ N ≤ H ∧ N.index ∣ n.factorial
